dialectic_function.description: Does this node do the right structural job at the right moment in the story? Thesis, antithesis deepening, turn, synthesis, catharsis — each has a job. Does this node do it?

tension_advancement.description: Does thematic tension increase across this node? Is the dramatic question getting harder to answer? Is the dialectic pressure building?

branch_choke_logic.description: If branch: does it create genuinely different dialectic experiences or just cosmetic variation? If choke: do all open branches actually reach it? If beat: does it earn its place in the chain?
